title: Postmortem – expired certificate, 10 Nov
author: Giulia Ferri
body:
What happened: on Tuesday 10 Nov the TLS certificate of the client portal expired overnight. The login page showed an error from 07:30 to 09:10.
Cause: nobody owned the renewal and there was no alert.
Fix: certificate renewed at 09:10.
Decision: we renew TLS certificates 30 days before they expire, with a reminder in the team calendar, so this cannot happen again.
Follow-up: task 'Set up certificate expiry reminders'.

title: Onboarding notes – new joiners
author: Giulia Ferri
body:
Welcome to Brightloop!

Working hours: core hours are 10:00-16:00, the daily stand-up is at 09:30 in #tech.
Code: every pull request needs one approval from a teammate before it is merged.
Releases: no production deploys after 15:00 on Fridays, because nobody wants to debug at the weekend.
Laptop: pick it up at the front desk on your first day.
Questions: ask in #tech, nobody bites.
